\caption{Datasets and the partitions they were trained on. Counts at each fraction are read from the fixed subset index files that every arm of every cell consumes, not recomputed from the percentage, so they include the rounding the per-class stratified draw introduces. Parentheses give images per class, which is what decides a cell's regime: $1\%$ of CIFAR-10 is 50 images per class while $1\%$ of Tiny-ImageNet is 5, and the prior behaves very differently at those two points. Dashes are fractions not run for that dataset; the two ImageNet stages were run at full data only. The relabeled controls (CIFAR-100-super, Tiny-ImageNet-20, -20b, -super, -semantic) and the multi-source views (EuroSAT-MS, So2Sat SAR/optical/both) reuse their parent's indices exactly, so they share its row. ciFAIR-100 \citep{barz2020cifair} is not listed: it replaces the CIFAR-100 \emph{test} set only, as a check that low-data gains are not memorized train/test duplicates, and has no training partition. Two kinds of blank are distinguished: $\times$ marks a fraction that \emph{cannot} be trained under the frozen recipe, because it yields fewer than one batch of 128 images and the loader is empty (the reason no dataset smaller than DTD has a 1\% cell); a dash marks a fraction that is runnable but that we did not run.}
